Messages.Author: Eric Topp
Messages.Body:
If a vampire with a Zombie retainer is in combat, does the opposing minion
take damage from the Zombie during the resolution of additional strikes?
--
Eric Topp
eric...@interact.net.au

Messages.Author: lisa
Messages.Body:
As with the Wolf Companion, I believe this damage only happens once in the
combat (in only one strike resolution) and only at close range.

Eric Topp a écrit dans le message <75fb0l$vei$1...@black.interact.net.au>...
